about.what: What this operator PC needs to know about the slots it drives: the drawing server, ROS settings, per slot whether it is mounted and its force sign, the tare and contact thresholds, the touch, the collision thresholds. Which robot hangs in which slot, its address and its DDS domain are the site table's (site_table), one source for each fact.
about.mounted_source: 2026-10-02: the arms under control are 2R and 3R (site/aris_2026-10.json live_note). Set `mounted` true for a slot only when its arm hangs there and answers on the site table's address.
about.force_sign_note: per arm: +1 when the paper pushing the pen up reads positive. The old stack needed -1 on arm 13; the first `aris touchoff <slot>` from the planning PC checks it: its report shows the sign of the force onset.
about.slots_note: arms are slots 1L 1R 2L 2R 3L 3R (DESIGN 4c); the old robot ids live on only in the site table

ros.joint_prefix_note: joint names are <joint_prefix>_joint1..7; the briefing notes one stack that used fr3v2

force.source: facts of this site about the force estimate (control-stack briefing 2026-09-09). How hard the pen presses (band, levels, cap, ramps, servo) is a fact of pen and paper: config/rig.json `pen`, carried in every job header.
force.tare_note: the force estimate in the air is not zero (2.5 N on arm 17 in the old stack was the clamp); a larger reading than this refuses the landing
force.cap_ticks_note: readings in a row over the pen's force cap before the arm holds

touch.source: the calibration touch under position control (DESIGN section 6 step 1; orchestrator 2026-10-01)
touch.cap_note: above the air zero at any reading: the arm stops where it is and holds; no way back is flown until a person has looked
touch.extra_note: a touch motion may go on past its planned end by its extra_depth, at most extra_max, at extra_speed

collision.source: set for a job in position tracking (mode A) and restored after it, as the old stack raised them before every pass (control-stack briefing 2026-09-09 section 9: 20 N -> 40 N; HARDWARE_DAY1 1.5: the installation operator's 40/40/36/36/32/28/24 Nm, fr3drivers' 'sensitive' 20 Nm / 20 N). Lower and upper thresholds, acceleration and nominal, all set to these.
collision.force_n_note: the Cartesian thresholds: x, y, z in N, then the three torques in Nm
